acceptance_criteria: A word typed without polish diacritics produces the same key as the correctly spelled word.
The digraph pairs ch/h, cz/c, sz/s and rz/z produce the same key.
Every rule in the class docblock rule table is pinned by at least one data-provider assertion.
behavior_anchors: polish word -> PhoneticPolish::phonetic_word -> readable phonetic key
goal: Add a documented Polish phonetic algorithm as PhoneticPolish and register it as language "pl" in Phonetic.
non_goals: Changing any already shipped language class.
